name: EcoSys (Malaysia) Berhad
overview: EcoSys (Malaysia) Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市，首次公开募股（IPO）发行145,696,000股新股。公司业务线UHP和Abatement在所提供的公告中未披露具体的运营变化。
overview_en: EcoSys (Malaysia) Berhad listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia in 2026 through an initial public offering (IPO) of 145,696,000 new shares. No specific operational changes for the UHP and Abatement business lines were disclosed in the provided announcements.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成IPO并在ACE市场上市。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the ACE Market in 2026.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH OUR LISTING ON THE ACE MARKET OF BURSA MALAYSIA SECURITIES BERHAD ("BURSA SECURITIES") C
actions.text: 进行首次公开募股，公开发行145,696,000股新股，并在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市。
actions.text_en: Conducted an initial public offering of 145,696,000 new shares and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
